raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

Preserve the user simulator's assistant tool calls and matching tool results when forwarding tau2 conversation history to the OpenAI-compatible client. The previous user-specific cleanup removed both, so the simulator could not see its own tool observations on later turns. Keep the existing removal of `tool_calls: null` for API compatibility.

Add a focused regression test for the tool-call/result pair and input-message immutability.

## Related Issue

Fixes #1741

## Type of Change

- [x] Bug fix

## Validation

- `uvx pre-commit run --files examples/tau2/agent.py tests/test_tau2_messages.py` passed.
- Ruff lint and format checks passed; `python3 -m compileall -q` passed.
- A dependency-free direct check of `_clean_messages` passed.
- `uv run --no-project --with pytest pytest tests/test_tau2_messages.py -q -rs` skipped because the optional `tau2` package is not installed locally.
- `uvx pre-commit run --all-files` completed all checks except the unrelated CLI documentation generator, whose system Python lacks `mdformat`; a retry with `mdformat` available reached a missing `omegaconf` dependency. No generated files changed.

## Checklist

- [x] I have read the Contributing Guide.
- [x] Relevant changed-file pre-commit hooks pass.
- [x] Regression test added; optional-dependency skip documented above.
- [x] Branch is based on the current `main` at preparation time.
- [x] This PR was created with a coding agent.

+from copy import deepcopy
+
+import pytest
+
+
+def test_clean_messages_preserves_tool_history():
+    pytest.importorskip("tau2")
+    from examples.tau2.agent import Tau2Runner
+
+    messages = [
+        {"role": "system", "content": "you are the user"},
+        {"role": "user", "content": "Have you tried turning it off and on?"},
+        {
+            "role": "assistant",
+            "content": None,
+            "tool_calls": [
+                {
+                    "id": "c1",
+                    "type": "function",
+                    "function": {"name": "check_status_bar", "arguments": "{}"},
+                }
+            ],
+        },
+        {
+            "role": "tool",
+            "tool_call_id": "c1",
+            "content": "Status bar shows: No Service",
+        },
+    ]
+    original_messages = deepcopy(messages)
+
+    cleaned = Tau2Runner._clean_messages(messages)
+
+    assert cleaned == messages
+    assert messages == original_messages
